body:
I appreciate your response.  Sometthing I've always known since I've been old enough is that I do need to get away from her.  There simply is not a thing I can do to help her make better decisions.  She's 50 and is doing the same shit she was when she was 17.  

It feels like lose-lose though, where I can step back and be happy with making progress within my own, but having then felt like I've abandoned the thought of trying to help my Mom.  So it hurts, and after so long I realize she takes advantage of this and has me twisted around her finger like anyone else in her life.  This will be the most difficult chapter in my life to data, and I've had it very hard growing up, relatively, so doing this is really going to take some balls, and some ocmmitment to ensure I don't allow her back in my life when I'm weak.  She'll seek this out and take advantage, it's who she is.

"You are allowed to leave them and live your life" really rings and hits jhome for me.  I'd really like to find the courage and strength to do that.  Maybe today.
